create_random_mutation_strategy: create a RandomMutationStrategy with operations, p_mutate, p_last, n_attr_min, and n_attr_max parameters
generate_new_task: generate a new task by mutating an existing task or creating one from scratch using new_task
mutate_task_with_operations: mutate an existing task using add, remove, merge, split, or input_transform operations
add_category_to_task: add a new compatible concept category to an existing task using add_category
remove_category_from_task: remove a random category from a task that has at least three classes using remove_category
